summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate) without running tests or committing, per instructions. Changes: added Update container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py (prologue, algebra); translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update, building the prologue from q.prologue[0] before the empty-request exit; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py and exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; processUpdate and the update processor are unchanged. New test module test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the spec behaviors. Open points: prepareUpdate sets _original_args, which adds a third attribute beyond the spec's two; the initial-bindings test (INSERT with empty WHERE) is unverified because nothing was run; the first prologue group is translated twice for non-empty requests, which is idempotent.
